About Momo

Ekjon manush ja code kore, golpo bhalobashe. Edit this text with your own story.

Write in the open

Every post is a plain Markdown file. Add one, and it appears on the site.

Two languages

Set lang: bn or lang: en at the top of each post.

Frequently asked questions

Ki niye lekho?

Golpo, chinta, ar code. Kokhono bangla, kokhono English — jeta mone ashe.

How do I add a new post?

Create a Markdown file in src/content/posts with a title, date and language, then push to GitHub.

Can I read only Bangla posts?

Yes. Open the blog page and choose বাংলা. The choice is saved in the link, so you can share it.
